content:
morgan: Heads-up — building sample-app for edge (Cloudflare) in mono repo fails during bundle: `Error: No matching export in "@rw/sdk" for import "./dist/index.mjs"`. Works in Node dev.

kevin: can you show import + package.json exports?

morgan: import: `import { RedwoodClient } from '@rw/sdk'`
package.json exports: {".":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"},"./*":"./*"}

jess: pnpm workspace symlink layout + package exports often trips esbuild/vite — bundler resolves through symlink to real path and then the exports check fails.

sam: quick fixes: (1) add vite/esbuild alias pointing at packages/sdk/dist/index.mjs, or (2) add an explicit subpath export matching what the bundler tries (e.g. "./dist/index.mjs":"./dist/index.mjs").

morgan: alias fix worked locally. Not sure we want to commit the extra export.

kevin: long-term: document the gotcha in SDK README, add a CI job that builds sample apps targeting edge, and consider setting `node-linker=hoisted` for the CI build step to avoid nested symlinks.

ci-bot: Created ticket RW-1901: "Build/sample-app edge bundle flake due to pnpm exports/symlink" assigned to morgan.

jess: add a short README note (Monorepo/workspace -> edge bundlers) with alias snippet and recommended CI test.

morgan: will open a PR with the vite alias and the README note. Thanks :rocket:
